law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Official Gazette of Montenegro 79/08, 70/09, 44/12, 22/17, 77/24)
jurisdiction: Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information (AZLP)
scope: Automated processing and manual filing-system processing of personal data; protects data subjects regardless of nationality or residence
applies_to: Controllers processing in Montenegro or where Montenegrin law applies; foreign controllers using Montenegro-located equipment (must appoint a local representative)
key_requirements: Information duty, consent unless processing is required by law, notification of filing systems; sensitive data needs legal justification or explicit consent; data-subject rights; sanctions imposed by courts, not the Agency (CMS)
data_categories: Personal data; special categories (racial/ethnic origin, political and religious beliefs, trade union, health, sex life, biometric data, criminal and misdemeanour records)
enforcement_authority: Agency for Personal Data Protection and Free Access to Information (AZLP)
penalties_range: Art. 74 misdemeanour fines: EUR 500-20,000 legal person; EUR 150-2,000 responsible person/natural person; EUR 150-6,000 entrepreneur
genetic_data: Not named in the special-categories list of the 2008 law (health and biometric data are) (unconfirmed)
